bar: READABLE requires K2 cosine-stable + AUC + specificity AND K3 causal steer; PATTERN-ONLY = attention/vectors read without steering; OPAQUE = neither reads nor steers

expectation.k1: attention lands on true binding when correct, recency/query on echo
expectation.k5: magnitude tracks B3 across rounds; nulls flat
expectation.scored: 1/5 (K1 partial only); K2/K5 miss openly; K3/K4 gated ABORT (expected modest steer — never tested)

k1.finding: depth-query attention does NOT read the answer on skilled states. Echo lines put AS MUCH or MORE mass on the true-binding pair as correct lines (s0 v1r2 0.58 correct vs 0.78 echo; s2 0.57 vs 0.81; rar3 same pattern). Tutor query-mass ~0 (never looks at query token). Only consistency: collapsed-state echo lines go diffuse (pair mass drops 0.3-0.4 vs correct, query/recency mass rises) 3/3 seeds — attention defocus marks collapse, not error.
k1.n: 200 reverse lines x 4 states x 3 seeds

k2.aucEchoDetector: 1 minus filed aucEcho (filed statistic was P(correct>echo); standard echo-detector AUC = P(echo>correct))
k2.finding: Each model's correct-vs-echo axis separates WITHIN seed (stacked echo-detector AUC 0.68 3/3; rbcoll 0.75-0.95; donly ~chance 0.51-0.57) but points NOWHERE consistent: cross-seed cosine ~0 for both directions on all 3 states. The axis is seed-idiosyncratic geometry shared between fit/held lines of the same model — not a universal knob. Specificity fails in the strong form: the skill-less collapsed state separates BEST.
k2.loutProjection: scattered (no consistent class across seeds/states) — directions do not name an answer class
k2.verdict: FAIL (cosine ~0 AND specificity fail). K2-gate TRIPS.

k3.reason: K2-gate tripped: echo-direction cosine ~0 across seeds (idiosyncratic, not universal) + specificity fail (echo-detector AUC strongest on skill-less rbcoll 0.75-0.95 vs stacked 0.68, donly ~chance). Steering a non-skill axis per prereg gate.

k5.finding: Projection gaps along the same-seed stacked direction are erratic, not monotonic: s0 0.82/1.23/-0.68, s1 0.27/-0.06/0.53, s2 0.07/-0.16/-0.27 across R1/R2/R3; nulls scattered (-0.37..0.28). Stacking is NOT direction growth along any stable axis.

verdict: OPAQUE (white-box certified): no universal direction (K2 cosine ~0), no attention readout of answer (K1), no tracking (K5); steering/ablation correctly gated unrun. The filed 'compiled/flat' story stands — now with geometric evidence, not just behavioral. Follow-up owed (own prereg): within-seed causal test is the remaining move, NOT a universal knob claim.
